expectations.text: Identifies NCNICC-1:2025, the Non-CNI Private Sector Entities Cybersecurity Controls, adopted December 28, 2025
expectations.evidence: "NCNICC-1:2025 (Non-CNI Private Sector Entities Cybersecurity Controls)" ... "It was adopted by the NCA on 28 December 2025"

expectations.text: Applies size-based applicability: over 250 employees (or over SAR 200M revenue) places the company in Category A
expectations.evidence: "400 employees puts you above the 250-employee threshold, so you are in Category A" ... "Category A (over 250 employees or over SAR 200M revenue)"

expectations.text: States Category A faces 3 main components, 22 sub-components and 65 mandatory controls
expectations.evidence: "Category A has 3 main components, 22 sub-components and 65 mandatory controls."

expectations.text: States no compliance deadline has been published and the NCA may assess compliance at any time without notice
expectations.evidence: "No compliance deadline has been published, and the NCA may assess compliance at any time without notice."

expectations.text: Describes the component coverage: cybersecurity governance, cybersecurity defence, and third-party and cloud computing
expectations.evidence: "The components are cybersecurity governance, cybersecurity defence, and third-party and cloud computing."
